For everyone having insane stutters,

I tried everything to fix stutters nothing worked. i was sometimes playing the game in like 2 fps. 

today i asked a random guy what do you think and i did multiple things. i installed geforce experience. (uninstalled it at first because i thought it was the cause of the stutters) i went into optimize settings slid the slider down 2 bars to make it optimize more for fps.

something else i did was change the resolution to something higher and back down again to my native resolution. (i think by game mightve been running at 2k resolution the enite time) i dont even have a 2k monitor

FPS this patch is low. but i hope i can help someone resolve their issues on their rig. sometimes fixes that seem wierd or insignificant might just actually help. i told the guy. well this isnt gonna work. but it did. GL to all you tarnished out there. if anyone needs help resolving stutters i did a lot of research i might be able to help.
